title: No skill-qualified strategies
detail: The genuine prediction ledger is empty. ROI, win rate, CLV, rank and reward points are unknown, not zero. No strategy is represented as luck-free, validated or profitable.

title: Quote-update timestamps are unavailable
detail: Fifteen primary DraftKings game-line rows were transcribed from its own public page. The page shows Server Time 11/04/2026 3:14:47 PM but does not establish the timezone or individual quote-update instants. Exact observation instants were also not logged. These are observed snapshots, not executable/live quotes; freshness gate HOLD.

title: NFL and operator kickoff disagree
detail: For LV at SF, the NFL schedule and injury page show Sunday November 8 at 4:25 PM EST; the DraftKings page renders 4:05 PM. The NFL governs fixture identity and kickoff locks. No inferred timestamp or venue is taken from the operator page.

title: Player-prop ladder cannot be paired safely
detail: Eight player names/event groups were visible in the reviewed first prop-page chunk. Animated digit strips and concatenated alternate thresholds/prices do not establish an unambiguous line/price pair. Every numerical prop quote is null. The rest of the paginated prop page was not audited and is not claimed complete.

title: Practice participation is not a game status
detail: All 28 JAX/BAL practice rows have blank injury and game-status cells in the retrieved Week 9 report. Other 28 playing teams render No Injuries Reported, which is not confirmation that each player is healthy, active or the starter. Participation gate HOLD until final game-specific evidence is established.

title: Complete operator settlement rulebook not established
detail: Introductory football/parlay guides were checked, but jurisdiction-specific market rules for overtime, ties, DNP, postponements, voids and SGP repricing were not verified. Two guessed help/house-rule URLs returned a 404 page; they are not used as valid references. The engine holds all ambiguous settlements and does not infer reduced parlay odds.

title: Baseline lines are untrained research outputs
detail: B0 averages each team's scoring rate with its opponent's concession rate, using the checked 32-team snapshot. Home advantage is exactly zero by declared benchmark design, not an empirical estimate. The same rule applies to Madrid. No injury adjustment, schedule-strength adjustment, probability distribution, uncertainty interval or predictive-skill evidence is available; edges and picks stay blank.

title: No parlay or prop-outcome correlation measured
detail: Standings/scoring correlations are descriptive. They do not estimate two specific wager-outcome indicators or justify rho=0 across games. Joint probabilities, leg correlations and correlation intervals remain blank until a matching historical sample is verified.

title: Inherited verification claims exceed the evidence
detail: This module inventories the entire starting commit 7c2f545 and separately compares 32 core standings rows, 15 fixture identities and 14 final-score rows with its newly checked source transcriptions. Inherited team/player statistics, old injuries, news details and third-party market values are not externally re-verified here; unsupported cells in the coverage export are null. Matching two inherited files is not official verification.

title: Shared dashboard corrections belong to other sessions
detail: At the starting commit, the root model subtracts signed home handicap from a home winning margin, admits unverified prices, treats CONDITIONAL as PASS and fabricates zero realized leaderboard points. Independent audit A-01…A-06 and correction PRs #8/#11 document those issues. This isolated module does not overwrite fresh root-integration claims. Its own engine uses margin plus signed handicap and requires every gate to be PASS.

title: Continuous production refresh is not installed by this module
detail: The build and integrity checks run unattended from checked snapshots, and the engine has real receipt/settlement APIs. There is no enabled source-refresh schedule, production strategy emitter or final-rulebook adapter in this isolated scope. Root owners must integrate automation after their checks. No claim of automatic live picks or ongoing weekly grading is made.

title: Source snapshots are selected-field transcriptions
detail: The official pages were read with fetch_page on 2026-11-04. Selected fields were transcribed to CSV, then every published source value was compared against those rows. Raw upstream HTML was not retained and exact per-page fetch timestamps were not logged. SHA-256 detects later changes to the local transcriptions; it cannot authenticate the original upstream response.

title: Jurisdiction and support text must not be assumed
detail: The inherited site incorrectly treated the user as being in the Netherlands. This module links the Washington regulator without making a personal legal determination: Washington's page limits sports wagering to qualifying tribal facilities and on-premises mobile use. The current NCPG help page lists call/text 1-800-MY-RESET (1-800-697-3738). No cash, purchase, wagering, accounts or location bypass is offered.

title: Statistical gates are project choices, not guarantees
detail: A 200-ticket/20-week screen, two holdouts, 5,000 week-block resamples, Holm adjustment and a frozen final evaluation are declared project policies. Exchangeable week clusters are an assumption; shared teams, serial dependence and regime changes can invalidate uncertainty estimates. A positive CLV or p-value does not remove luck or prove durable profitability.

title: Operator odds guide contains an inconsistent fractional example
detail: The checked reading-odds guide gives a 3/1 fractional example, then writes '3 by 4' while concluding 25%. Those statements are arithmetically inconsistent. Only the separately checked American/decimal formulae are used by this module; the fractional paragraph is excluded.

title: Inherited Chargers CSV row has an extra column
detail: Starting-commit data/nfl-2026-standings.csv physical line 17 (LAC) has more fields than its header. The extra zero shifts the trailing streak/games_played/source/data_as_of labels. The inventory preserves an unlabeled-surplus-column flag and leaves affected fields null. Only independently matched core fields are retained; the shared CSV is not changed by this session.
